modalities.evidence: A T1-weighted scan of head anatomy was also acquired

output.population: 16 volunteers from both sexes (8 female, 8 male) with an average age of 25 years, screened to exclude prior neurological or psychiatric diagnoses
output.summary: Emotional face perception task fMRI with a preceding resting-state run and anatomical scans in healthy volunteers, acquired on a 3-Tesla scanner in a single session and optimized for multivariate pattern analysis.
